cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make the Choice Rewrite the Past
cards.instruction: Make them choose between options whose consequences reinterpret an earlier promise, refusal, or agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Choose the overseas job or our shared shop. Then we'll know what 'we'll build something' meant.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said that before the offer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Yes. This choice gives the old sentence its ending.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're making a job sound like a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm asking whether your promise has room for the shop without you.

mechanism: Copy a witness signature as business commitment, then force a job-versus-shop choice to redefine an earlier promise to build something together.
confusable: Not only an ultimatum: B2 must expose A's misunderstood signature role, and the corrected role must shape the choice offered.
comparison: Business roles and remote funding differ from a relationship's spare key and need for space.
seedUse: Retains overseas job/shared shop/earlier together promise; introduces witness versus partner signature.
